description: MainActivity class for an Android TV To-Do application. It hosts two fragments: TaskListFragment and EditTaskFragment, manages navigation between them, and handles fragment lifecycle events.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main activity for the Android TV To-Do app, responsible for hosting fragments and managing navigation.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets theme and content view, and loads the TaskListFragment if activity is created fresh.

methods.name: onAddNewTask
methods.description: Handles navigation to the EditTaskFragment for creating a new task.

methods.name: onEditTask
methods.description: Handles navigation to the EditTaskFragment for editing an existing task identified by taskId.

methods.name: onDoneEditing
methods.description: Handles returning from the editing fragment, popping the back stack.
